items.description:
Listed primarily by the language which can be used for interoperability / FFI.
Language section does not necessarily mean the language of the implementation. For example compiles into but the compiler is written in . Or interops with but it is mostly written in . In case of it contains only small amounts of , but it is implemented almost entirely in .
